Add DATA_PROVENANCE.md to the official development package as an internal provenance ledger; do not publish it in the runtime deployment.
Add THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md for the audited OCR/runtime dependency and model license inventory.

Keep checkpoint compatibility and diagnostic JSON/CSV payloads unchanged; keep recognition core five byte-identical to Candidate95.
Prevent pull-to-refresh at all times with page-level overscroll-behavior:none; keep the existing analysis-time touch fallback unchanged.

Embed the byte-identical food-empty reference image directly in app.js as an image/jpeg data URL; remove assets/food-empty-reference.png from the public package and Service Worker precache without changing empty-food scoring, thresholds, or confirmation logic.
Add Foongus/タマゲタケ and Amoonguss/モロバレル to master_data.js from the current nitoyon/pokesleep-tool src/data/pokemon.json and Japanese name map; keep classifier/app/food matching algorithms unchanged.
